narrative: In the glass. Burbage looks straight out of it. His own place is an empty oval, marked W. S.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the house should not hide, and named Heminges as the first of the three.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: Called from Holywell, set the two men at sixpence and the chain after the play, and yielded on the flag.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Walked the playhouse with a lantern. He was not on the call. His son reported him.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Not on the call. You said the flag had been his opinion first.
